title: Ideal Fixed Gear Transmission
text: Ideal fixed gear transmission without clutch or synchronization, 3 outputs, {Gear property interpolation method} sets Interpolation; {Efficiency factors} sets the efficiency calculation, {Gear number vector, G} sets the number of transmission speeds, {Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} sets the breakpoints, {Gear ratio vector, N} sets the ratio of input speed to output speed, {Inertia vector, Jout} sets the gear rotational inertia, {Damping vector, bout} sets the gear viscous damping coefficient, {Efficiency vector, eta} sets the gear efficiency, {Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} sets the gear efficiency array, {Initial gear number, G_o} sets the gear, {Initial output velocity, omega_o} sets the output speed, {Initial neutral input velocity, omegainN_o} sets the neutral gear input speed and {Shift time constant, tau_s} sets the time .01. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Efficiency factors
params.values: Specify efficiency calculation Gear only (default) | Gear, input torque, input speed, and temperature

params.name: Gear property interpolation method
params.values: Interpolation Nearest (default) | Linear | Flat | Cubic spline

params.name: Gear number vector, G
params.values: Specify number of transmission speeds [-1,0,1,2,3,4,5] (default) | vector

params.name: Gear ratio vector, N
params.values: Ratio of input speed to output speed [-4.47,4.47,4.47,2.47,1.47,1,0.8] (default) | vector
